question: As of April 2022, who among the following is the Chairman of the National Green Tribunal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adarsh Kumar Goel.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adarsh Kumar Goel** was appointed as the **Chairman** of the **National Green Tribunal **(NGT) in** July 2018.**
 
• He is a former **Supreme Court Judge** and has also served as the **Chief Justice of the Odisha High Court** and the **Gauhati High Court.**
 
• Since taking office, Goel has ensured that all **benches are operational** by using video conferencing to hear cases from the benches in Bhopal, Chennai, Kolkata, and Pune.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Former Chief Justice of India** Uday Umesh Lalit is an Indian lawyer and former Supreme Court judge. 

 
 
• He worked as a** senior lawyer** at the Supreme Court before being elevated to the position of judge.
 
 
 
• **Judge Anoop Kumar Mendiratta** hails from India.
 
 
• He is a** judge of the Delhi High Court** at the moment. He was the** Law Secretary **of India in the past.
 
 
 
• **Judge Vikram Nath** sits on the Indian Supreme Court.
 
 
• He was a **judge on the Allahabad High Court **as well as the **chief justice of the Gujarat High Court.**
